source: due2-native: a duration right operand that mixes year-month and day-time parts (#116)
notes: The policy is valid ODRL 2.2 and passes odrl22-shape.ttl; the rejection is due2's. XSD cannot order P1Y2D against P367D: a year is 365 or 366 days, so the first equals the second or is a day longer, depending on where it starts. A policy writes one kind, such as P1Y or P367D.

expected_rejection.why: The right operand "P1Y2D"^^xsd:duration of ex:age's constraint mixes a year-month part, 1Y, with a day-time part, 2D. W1 rejects the policy in stage 2 (due2-profiles.md §4).
